title: Why Easy Goals Make You Less Motivated
hook: Ever feel less motivated when a task seems too simple?

narration.text: Your brain can actually lose interest in goals that feel too easy.
This is called the optimal challenge theory.
We are most motivated when a goal is just beyond our current skill level.
If a task is too simple, it offers no room for growth or learning.
No challenge means no sense of achievement when you complete it.
So, to stay motivated, aim for goals that stretch you slightly.
Have you noticed this feeling when a goal is too easy for you?

description: It sounds counterintuitive, but sometimes an easy goal is the hardest to achieve. Discover why the optimal challenge theory explains this surprising aspect of human motivation. Understanding this can help you set better goals.
topic: Why you sometimes feel less motivated to achieve a goal if it seems too easy, explaining optimal challenge theory.
